integrity: Original paper fixes P_n and proves N=(w); the additional module invariants are calculated here. Exact finite computations support an all-n proof but are not substituted for it.
scientific_limitations: Does not compute N^k/N^{k+1} for k>=2 or graded arc-space indices.
The nilpotent-index upper bound is not asserted sharp.
Historical publication-priority assessment is qualified; no independent mathematical audit.
title: The finite complete-intersection nilradical of a hypergeometric Kleinian critical scheme
